title: Impressible
summary: IMPRESS'IBLE, adjective That may be impressed; that yields to pressure; that may receive impressions. Solid bodies are not easily impressible 1. That may be impressed; that may have its figure stamped

inlines.v: IMPRESS'IBLE, adjective That may be impressed; that yields to pressure; that may receive impressions. Solid bodies are not easily impressible 1. That may be impressed; that may have its figure stamped on another body.
